purpose: Exploratory retrospective comparisons and development-only OFAT/ablations. No model fitting, tuning or controller selection on evaluation outcomes.
sensitivity_episode_rationale: Full24h episodes on the three predeclared development blocks. Full episodes retained after performance-only cached-solver timing indicated a practical runtime, before examining sensitivity outcomes. Three days do not support independent-replicate or generality claims. Full49 comparison also uses144 intervals per block.
capacity_sensitivity_scaling: SOC percentages, initial/reserve/terminal50% references scale with capacity; power unchanged, so C-rate also changes.
alpha_sensitivity: Rolling signed order statistic alpha changes; inherited static floor stays fixed. This is not a newly calibrated nominal coverage guarantee.
grid_penalty_ablation: Removing only secondary exceedance leaves primary grid-ramp priority active. Primary-disabled variant retains the secondary penalty. A separate no_grid_penalties variant disables primary priority, secondary exceedance and absolute grid ramp penalties; battery ramp and operational penalties remain.
